summary: Bhutan’s landscape is overwhelmingly dominated by forest cover, comprising 26,670.64 km² or 68.8 % of the national land area.  The next most extensive land‑use categories are alpine scrubs at 3,444.65 km² (8.9 %) and snow and glacier areas at 1,870.35 km² (4.8 %).  Agricultural land occupies only 1,148.91 km² (3.0 %), while built‑up areas are minimal at 97.75 km² (0.3 %).
